segments.text: Calibrate the red spot position for the welding head.
Calibrate the left or right offset.
If you use the pre-installed welding nozzle for laser welding,
perform a left or right offset calibration
when the laser spot deviates left or right from the wire,
despite proper nozzle installation.
On the touch screen of the main unit,
tap System Settings, Machine Settings,
Enter Administrator Settings.
Then input the eight-digit password, 8888888.
To the right of red spot position offset, tap Start.
Then tap the left arrow to decrease the offset
and move the red spot leftward.
Tap the right arrow to increase the offset
and move the red spot rightward.
When the center of the red spot falls at the welding wire,
tap Completed.
Calibrate the up or down offset.
When a cutting nozzle is used,
the laser beam may strike the nozzle's inner wall,
resulting in either blockage or reflection.
In such cases, perform left or right offset calibration.
If the problem persists,
reset the red spot position offset to zero
and try calibrating the up or down offset.
Welding and cleaning nozzles have larger apertures
and typically do not require such adjustment.
Insert the hex key into hole one or hole two
and slowly turn the screw
while observing the light emitting from the nozzle.
If a clear red spot appears, stop turning the screw.
